name: jevshift
description: Experimental Jev-assisted model and effort selection for Claude Code: observe, pin, off, and opt-in auto.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Observe, auto and pinned models with automatic effort send bounded, best-effort redacted conversation excerpts to OpenRouter / TypeSafe Jev. Claude Code manages sensitive storage; leave blank to use manual pins/off without Jev.

use_environment_key.title: Use OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable
use_environment_key.description: Explicitly allow reading the inherited environment key when no sensitive plugin key is configured. Sends the same context to OpenRouter / TypeSafe Jev.

experimental_auto.title: Enable experimental auto control
experimental_auto.description: Allow /jevshift auto for isolated alpha testing. Selection quality and broad live evaluator reliability remain under evaluation; new sessions still start observe.

claude_executable.title: Claude executable for model discovery
claude_executable.description: Claude executable on PATH, or its absolute path. Runs bounded no-inference SDK helpers in safe mode to resolve family aliases.

max_effort.title: Highest JevShift effort
max_effort.description: Highest effort JevShift may select: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Native settings remain under Claude Code control.
